summary: Iteration 85 — PREVIEW security fix + deliverable tokens + 'Upgrade all documents' + QA Cleanup™. Ran 17 pytest cases (all PASS) covering signed file+action+user tokens, inline vs attachment headers, public storefront intact, token security violations (no-token/scope-mismatch/tampered/cross-file), the batch status endpoint and full QA lifecycle (mark → soft-delete → restore → permanent-delete safeguard → published-protection). Full UI verified end-to-end on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844): DeliverablePreview modal opens inline PDF with a token-carrying iframe (no &download=1), separate 'Download original' + 'Open in new tab' actions, Product Detail preview works, Governance Publication Ops shows 94 eligible / 94 processed / 94 succeeded / 0 failed / Status=Complete, and the QA Cleanup permanent-delete confirmation stays disabled until the EXACT product title is typed.

issues: Radix DialogContent warnings 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined}' (accessibility hint) — cosmetic, does not affect UX.

action_items: Optional a11y hardening: add aria-describedby (or DialogDescription) to DeliverablePreview and QA dialogs to silence Radix warnings.

Note: In the request the trash-<id> testids were described as 'trash-item-<id>' where <id> is the product id, but the implementation uses trash-item-<TRASH_RECORD_ID> (t.id). Same for trash-restore- / trash-perm-. This is fine (trash records have their own ids and the UI list keys are unique), but consider aligning the docs to the code.
critical_code_review_comments: Preview iframe URL is minted server-side with an HS256 JWT bound to (fid, uid, action, exp≈10min) — solid scoping. Verify path in /app/backend/routers/rendering.py returns 403 for missing/mismatched fid/act, 401 for expired.

Response headers for protected deliverables correctly set: Content-Disposition inline vs attachment; Cache-Control 'private, no-store, max-age=0'; Referrer-Policy 'no-referrer'; X-Content-Type-Options 'nosniff'.
Public assets (cover-*/thumb-*/store-*/qr-*) remain reachable without a token — /api/rendering/asset/<cover>.png returned 200; /api/public/home and /api/public/books returned 200.
Raw deliverable-*.pdf without token → 403 (was previously 200) — regression closed.

Publication-quality re-render job is idempotent (guard against duplicate 'running' start), reports total/done/ok/failed/failed_ids, persists in mongo (deliverable_rerender_jobs) so status survives reload.

QA Cleanup: soft-delete cleans decoder.manufactured_products and decrements KR products_created; restore reinserts and re-increments. Permanent-delete re-asserts published/paid blockers even from trash. Good defense-in-depth.

Zero AI/LLM/cover spend during preview and batch — /rerender-documents worker calls ensure_deliverable(build_marketing=False, allow_ai_cover=False). Preview never regenerates. Backend logs' LiteLLM entries are the unrelated periodic background task on a ~12min cadence; they are NOT preview/upgrade triggers.
seed_data_creation: None. Marked AI Literacy — Lesson Plan qa_status=test → soft-deleted → restored → qa_status=null. Final DB state: trash count=0, marked_total=0, product intact with status='Needs Review', qa_status=None.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend + frontend both verified against https://understanding-os.preview.emergentagent.com. Key data-testids used: shelf-preview-<id>, deliverable-preview, preview-frame, preview-download-original, preview-open-newtab, pd-open-reader, pd-download-pdf, pd-qa-status (native <select>), publication-ops, ops-eligible-count, ops-upgrade-btn, ops-progress, ops-complete-report, qa-cleanup-panel, qa-item-<pid>, qa-delete-<pid>, qa-delete-confirm, qa-delete-confirm-btn, qa-delete-reason, trash-item-<TRASH_RECORD_ID>, trash-restore-<TRASH_RECORD_ID>, trash-perm-<TRASH_RECORD_ID>, qa-perm-confirm, qa-perm-title, qa-perm-confirm-btn. NOTE the trash-* ids are keyed on the trash record id, not the product id. The batch was already completed prior (94/94) so ops-upgrade-btn was still visible; a fresh re-click would only re-run if backend allows. All real products left untouched.
